svg.aria-label: The two steps that link uv's files: resolve turns the ranges in pyproject.toml (pandas>=3.0.5) into exact pins in uv.lock (pandas 3.0.5 with hashes and markers), and install turns uv.lock into packages in .venv (pandas and numpy in site-packages).
